profile.name: Neha Mayacharya
profile.tagline: Perception, powered by design + AI. Designing the intelligent interface.
profile.bio: I design experiences at the intersection of intelligent systems and spatial computing, intuitive, empathetic, and technically grounded. Over five years, I've delivered 20+ digital products across healthcare, enterprise, and education: it runs from AI-driven dashboards and conversational interfaces to immersive VR therapy programs and luxury metaverse retail. I move fluidly between 2D UX and 3D interaction design, between research insight and shipped product. Currently completing an Executive Master's in Artificial Intelligence (GPA 4.0), sharpening the bridge between design craft and machine intelligence.
profile.availability: Available 2026 · STEM OPT · Open to roles & collaborations

story: Over five years, I've delivered 20+ digital products across healthcare, enterprise, and education, from AI-driven dashboards and conversational interfaces to immersive VR therapy programs and luxury metaverse retail. I move fluidly between 2D UX and 3D interaction design, between research insight and shipped product.
I'm currently completing an Executive Master's in Artificial Intelligence (GPA 4.0), sharpening the bridge between design craft and machine intelligence. Authorized to work in the U.S. on STEM OPT.

experience.desc: Redesigned complex financial workflows using user research, reducing task completion time by 20%. Built responsive, WCAG-accessible dashboards with QR-based expense tracking.

Led end-to-end XR design across Web, VR, AR, and MR while managing cross-functional 3D and dev teams. Key work: TD Bank WebAR (One Vanderbilt NYC), Harvard MedTech VR therapy, Modelo × Seattle Kraken, Millennium Meta Quest 2 training, IFSG luxury metaverse retail.

Designed immersive solutions for global clients including TD Bank, Richemont, and Vicon Security. Bridged 2D UX and 3D interaction design across Figma, Adobe XD, and Unity 3D, and mentored junior designers.
Designed VR-based STEM curriculum improving student comprehension by 35% through immersive, evidence-backed storytelling. Owned the full design lifecycle from research to deployment.
Designed VR experiences for the healthcare domain.
Early product and industrial design practice, from studio work at Srishti to an internship at the Industrial Design Centre, IIT Bombay.
